resources.string:
Can't reach the FlipSign server at %1$s
(%2$s)

Retrying every 10 seconds. Press ≡ (Menu) on the remote to change the address.
Enter the address of your FlipSign server, the same address you use for the control page on your phone, without /control/. For example: http://192.168.1.50:3000
Start FlipSign when the Fire TV turns on
No FlipSign server answered at %1$s. Check the address and that the server is running, or save it anyway to keep retrying.
Start at boot needs a one-time step on this Fire TV (granting \"display over other apps\" from a computer). See \"Start at boot\" in the FlipSign README.
Press ≡ (Menu) on the remote any time to come back here. On the board, Back is ignored so a stray press can\'t take the sign down; Home leaves FlipSign. FlipSign %1$s · github.com/joedanz/flipsign
